answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. Orchid society membership with show bloom records is the check: blooms shown under one society across seasons. A farm faking 379 aliases needs 379 separate bloom records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the plume signal is public, the pigment check is automatic, and 379 aliases cost 379 times what one real agent costs, with the ocean trail open to all.
